description: Shared test vectors of the HTTP query parameter substituter (datatug-apps spec/features/http-query-parameters). The canonical copy is datatug-core pkg/datatug/testdata/http_template_vectors.json; datatug-apps keeps a byte-identical copy that its tests read. Modes: save = ValidateParameters(parameters); run = Substitute(parameters, values); server = SubstituteHTTPRunParameters(runParameters). An error matches on code and, when present, parameter, position and header; an expect object lists only the fields to compare (an empty object means success). render pins RenderHTTPParameterValue: expect null means the value cannot be coerced.
